text: NARROW store pilot is integrated: shared BidsStore[F] exposes only stable recursive file entries and UTF-8 reads; InMemoryBidsStore provides deterministic read/list failure injection on JVM and JS; JVM BidsPathStore owns Path, Throwable, blocking, and Resource concerns; BidsProjectLoaderF now assembles from the store and has no direct NIO logic. Verification before the final Path metadata assertion: bidsJVM/test passed 68 and bidsJS/test passed 54. Added a direct Path-store size/read/containment test and hardened root inspection error translation; final rerun remains pending because SBT escalation is temporarily denied.
